title: Zenith Irish Oat Tagine
description: A hearty, comforting Irish oat dish with a nutty flavor, featuring graham cracker crumbs and cooked to perfection in a clay tagine, perfect for a lazy Sunday morning.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the oats, graham cracker crumbs, brown sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, and vanilla extract.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Melt the butter and pour it into the tagine, then add the oat mixture.
Cover the tagine with a lid and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the top is lightly golden brown.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
